title: General.
officialText:
Structural sawn lumber; end-jointed lumber prefabricated wood I-joists; structural glued-laminated
timber; wood structural panels, fiberboard sheathing (when used structurally); hardboard siding (when used
structurally); particleboard; preservative-treated wood; structural log members; structural composite lumber; round
timber poles and piles; fire-retardant-treated wood; hardwood plywood; wood trusses; joist hangers; nails; and staples
shall conform to the applicable provisions of this section.
